beats.line: And because those bright lights never turn off, you lose all sense of time
never knowing whether it's been days, weeks, or even months
since you last saw a shadow. There's been reports of
prisoners remaining locked in this sensory void
for up to eight months, and some of them
have claimed that even years after leaving
they have never been the same. Number three: Veryovkina Cave
Veryovkina Cave, also known as the Death Pit
is located in the mountain region of Georgia
and is officially the deepest known cave on the entire planet
